original_registry_entry.issuing_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
original_registry_entry.exact_document_title: Atopic eczema in under 12s: diagnosis and management
original_registry_entry.version: NICE clinical guideline CG57; last updated 2025-09-22
original_registry_entry.jurisdiction: England, United Kingdom; international guidance requiring UAE adaptation
original_registry_entry.population: Children from birth up to 12 years with suspected or diagnosed atopic eczema.
original_registry_entry.clinical_setting: Primary, community and specialist assessment and management of paediatric atopic eczema.
original_registry_entry.applicability_note: Supports documenting paediatric atopic-eczema diagnosis features, severity and quality-of-life assessment, trigger review, education, adherence, treatment discussion and referral criteria. It does not generate a diagnosis, medicine, dose or UAE pathway.

exact_sections.heading: Recommendations 1.1 — diagnosis and assessment
exact_sections.evidence_summary: Supports recording itch, visible dermatitis pattern, previous flexural dermatitis, dry skin, atopic history and age at onset as diagnosis-assessment context without autonomous diagnosis.

exact_sections.heading: Recommendations 1.2 — assessing severity, psychological and psychosocial wellbeing and quality of life
exact_sections.evidence_summary: Supports clinician-documented severity, sleep, psychosocial and quality-of-life impact review.

exact_sections.heading: Recommendations 1.3 and 1.4 — trigger factors and education
exact_sections.evidence_summary: Supports documenting trigger or irritant review, education, adherence discussion and agreed follow-up.

exact_sections.heading: Recommendations 1.7 — indications for referral
exact_sections.evidence_summary: Supports clinician-recorded referral consideration for severe, refractory or diagnostically uncertain paediatric eczema.
